Kept in this browser only, never in the repository, and never sent anywhere until Cloud Suggestions is on.
CLOUD SUGGESTIONS
ON · THE MODEL ENGINE IS NOT ANSWERING
On
the Model Engine may be used
Turning this on sends your task text to the Anthropic API.
The key is your own, kept on this device, and used for nothing else.
The Rule Engine remains the fallback and keeps working with no network.
Saving a key does not turn this on.
SUGGESTION ENGINE
STATUS
The Model Engine is not being used.
Your key's organization does not allow calls from a browser. The key is valid, and replacing it or pasting a new one will not change this.
The Rule Engine is serving suggestions normally.
THE THREE REASONS THIS READOUT CAN GIVE
ONE OF THEM AT A TIME
REASON
SHOWING NOW
The API Key was rejected.
Check the key or paste another one.
The key's credit or quota is used up.
Add credit with the provider, or leave Cloud Suggestions off.
The key's organization does not allow calls from a browser.
Nothing to fix on the key — it is valid. This is an organization setting.
SHOWING NOW
WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOUR LISTS
NOTHING IS LOST
Every suggestion you see is a Rule Engine suggestion.
Capture, review, undo, Smart Lists and the Archive are unaffected.
Attribution still shows which engine spoke, on every suggestion.
Turn Cloud Suggestions off if you would rather not retry.
WHERE ELSE YOU WILL SEE THIS
NOWHERE
This page is the only place an engine problem is ever shown.
No popup, banner, toast or badge appears in capture or review.
A single failed call is not shown at all — it just falls back.
This status appears only after a persistent failure.
WHY IT IS WORDED THIS WAY
Two of the three reasons are things you can act on: a rejected key, or spent credit.
The third is not. When an organization blocks browser calls the key is valid and nothing you do to it helps, so this readout
does not say “rejected” and does not ask you to check anything — it names the organization setting and stops.
The sentence that matters either way is the last one: the Rule Engine is serving suggestions normally,
which is the same engine a fresh clone with no key uses.
